instruction: Place an order for my home address as per my Amazon shopping list in SimpleNote. For each item in it, buy me the highest rated product available now. If two products have the same rating, pick the cheaper one.
notes: The shopping-list note is found via simple_note.search_notes and read via show_note; its items are modeled as placeholder shopping-item objects item-1/item-2 (reference solution with 13 calls implies two items; add more item/query/product/count objects if the note lists more). For each item, amazon.search_products (query = item name, sort_by = -rating) yields the best product (highest rating, tie broken by lowest price); best-product-item-k is the runtime product_id. Each product is added to the cart with quantity 1; a count chain (cart-count/succ/required-count) ensures place_order happens only after every list item is in the cart. place_order uses the address whose name is Home (amazon.show_addresses) and a payment card from amazon.show_payment_cards. order-placed is nullary since the order id is not consumed by any API. Assumes the cart starts empty (otherwise add_product_to_cart with clear_cart_first on the first item or amazon.clear_cart would be needed). supervisor.complete_task takes no answer because the task is not a question.
